frames.description: A vibrant outdoor Holi festival unfolds under a clear blue sky on a sunny day, with a large crowd of young adults joyfully celebrating amidst clouds of colored powder. Participants, mostly in their late teens to thirties, are drenched in bright pinks, yellows, and purples, their white t-shirts now tie-dye masterpieces. Many wear glasses, some with colorful powder smeared across their faces and hair, laughing and dancing in groups. The camera captures a medium-wide shot from slightly below eye level, showing full bodies and faces in the foreground with a deep field revealing more revelers, green trees, a modern building with large windows, and a yellow event tent in the background. The lighting is bright and direct, casting sharp shadows and enhancing the saturated hues of the powder against the neutral tones of the pavement and architecture. The atmosphere is energetic, communal, and celebratory, with people embracing, throwing powder, and moving rhythmically. The scene suggests a college campus or public park event during spring or early summer. Approximately 50-70 people are visible. ocr.all_text: JUNE AND AUGUST JAY DEV adjustments to be made, no promises to keep, no dates to remember, no one to take care of. Life's already so complicated. And most importantly, the speed and style at which I am running at my dreams, I don't think he will be able to match it any day. But I do want to pull someone's beard and play with his hair and sleep in his arms. I am mad. That got me thinking about what kind of boy I can handle or let's put it in a better phrasing, someone who can think of handling me throughout till my last breath. I mean, of course, this pretty face will greet him with a sweet voice every early morning, but this lady demands breakfast to be made and have a no-phone dinner with her. I have been talking to Samayra regarding it, but I guess we are split on this topic, and now we both have our internal exams coming up. We had reached home. "I want someone just like my father," Samayra said. Spreading a new bedsheet, she spoke, "Isn't that what every girl wants in her guy? Whatever relationship you have with your dad, you want someone who can replace him. He has to be sweetly strict. He has to be someone who can lift me in his arms and ..." I threw a pillow at her. "You and your daddy fantasies!" For me, well, the first prerequisite I guess that I need in my guy is that he should be able to play badminton, better if he can beat me in it. That's something I wish to do every day with my guy. I mean, it isn't an ideal date plan, but imagine barefoot on the grass, each other trying to hit that shuttle hard into the bosom. Well, I guess I have made exclusive pictorial representation out of it, but imagine I slipping as I try to return the shuttle and he scrambling to aid me. Such a sweet moment that will be. We can probably share a kiss too. It depends if one of the other isn't breathily heavily. Why the hell am I smiling? Gosh, I can turn into a romantic maniac. I believe love is not about filling that space between the fingers. Instead, it's about running along the way of life, helping each other keep balance. There are a girl and a boy. Both are happy and content with themselves and their lifestyle. They get together for a brighter future and lots of fun (some tears) together. 14 Exams are a fortnight away. People are doing internships and part-time jobs along with study. And I have been lazing around a while, selectively liking Hrithik Roshan's individual photos. I skip over when he is with some actress. I think one day when I meet him; I can say I was the one who never liked your couple pics because I know you are meant for me! I have started so many leadership and management related online courses but never managed to complete them. I need to watch how I spend my time. I spend it doing all sorts of crazy things that you, my dear diary, are unfamiliar with. You would wonder what I do when I am left alone at Home? I always wanted to try the trouser and suit of Abbu. I just want to roam around the house draped in the towel, as shown in movies. Back in Kashmir, I used to do some gardening and maybe plant some more here. But most importantly, I will watch that mole 5 cm right to my navel for hours; for some reason, I find it so intriguing. I love Samayra as she sleeps in my lap, with her heart pounding softly. I love my friends with whom I have my lunch and go to the classes. I love the route I take every day to college, my usual seat and the list goes on and on. I guess they are okay till they don't get too close to me. Then I start thinking about hanging out more with them. I start doing things that I would never have done. This is something that makes me shun people a bit away from me. People realize it or I may portray it as something cold-hearted but it's just that I am an over-sensitive and emotional girl. You spend a day with me and you will get to know me. Partially! Because what goes inside my heart is always smartly shadowed by the workings of my brain. I might ignore you but deep down, my heart is racing fast. I will smirk at you as my heart smiles. I will bitch about you when I am flattered by your personality. I will say, "You are ugly" and call you names when I am charmed by that infectious grin of yours. I will say, "Buzz Off, please" when I want you to tease me more. And most importantly, I will block you because I like You. Aren't you thinking diary that how lame this girl is? Are you wondering if she is some sort of mental, who wouldn't? I don't like 15
